The petitioner is seeking regular bail by way of petition filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C in case FIR No.05 dated 25.04.2023 registered under Sections 120-B, 386, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 506 of the IPC registered at Police Station Cyber Crime Sonepat, District Sonepat.

2. Contention of learned counsel is that co-accused Rakesh Kumar Yadav has already been allowed bail by this Court vide order dated 11.09.2023 passed in CRM-M-37123-2023 and case of the petitioner is on better footing.
Mr. Parveen Kumar Aggarwal, DAG, Haryana accepts notice on behalf of respondent- State.

5. Custody certificate has been placed on record by learned State 1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2023:PHHC:122833 2023:PHHC:122833 CRM-M-45845-2023 (O&M) -2- counsel revealing that petitioner is in custody for the last 04 months and 05 days with no criminal antecedents.
Learned State counsel concedes that case of the petitioner is at least on parity with co-accused Rakesh Kumar Yadav.
